S01: High above the clouds, at the top of the world, lived a horse with wings.
S02: Every day he flew across the sky and carried the thunderbolts of the king of gods.
S03: No mortal could ride this special horse.
S04: Zeus, the king of all gods, himself received the thunderbolts.
S05: Every bolt blazed with its own heavenly radiance.
S06: But far below the mountain, lived a young prince.
S07: Bellerophon was named for the hardest task: to defeat the legendary monster.
S08: But in him was born a bold idea.
S09: Far away, in a smoky rock, lived a terrible monster.
S10: The Chimera had the body of a goat, the head of a lion and a serpent's tail, and its jaw was fiery.
S11: Not a single mortal had yet ridden the winged horse.
S12: Bellerophon: "That winged horse shall become my secret weapon in the battle with the Chimera."
S14: Bent on his secret thought, he begged the goddess for help.
S15: In his dream appeared the goddess of wisdom herself.
S16: Athena looked upon him with a kind smile and whispered him a secret.
S18: In her hands gleamed pure gold.
S19: Athena: "Take these golden bridles. Go to the spring Pirene. When Pegasus lands to drink, place them around his neck and tame him."
S20: When he woke, beside him he found the golden bridles, a gift from the goddess.
S21: The gold gleamed in his hands.
S22: He went where the goddess had told him, toward the spring Pirene.
S23: There flowed pure, icy water through the green valley.
S24: Bellerophon hid behind the rocks and waited.
S25: A shadow descended upon the water, and the winged horse came down to the spring.
S26: There he saw it, calmly drinking its water.
S27: Bellerophon crept up behind it without a sound.
S28: With one careful motion he placed the bridles around its neck.
S29: The creature did not grow alarmed and did not throw him off.
S30: Then he mounted the winged horse.
S32: The first beat of the wings lifted them toward the sky.
S33: They simply flew off into the morning sky.
S34: High above the clouds, the world became small.
S35: The wind fluttered his cloak as they flew.
S36: Suddenly his gaze settled calmly upon the horizon.
S37: Far away, at the edge of sight, their adventure rose.
S39: Suddenly the volcanic mountain rose before them, from which the monster came.
S40: Bellerophon did not waver; his heart was full of courage.
S42: Before them lay a dangerous adventure.
